custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Focus Kept" in Search so only this case's work orders show.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  4. Using only the keyboard, focus the Alpha Co card, open its more-actions menu, open "Reassign lead technician", then close the dialog with Cancel (or Escape). Note where focus is.
  5. Click Status, tick "Approved" only, then by keyboard focus the Golf Co card. In the second browser change Golf Co's status to In Progress, then refresh your board (F5). Note where focus is, then press Tab once and note where it goes.
  6. Clear the Status filter. By keyboard focus Ben's column. In the second browser deactivate Ben (Settings > Staff > Ben > Edit Staff Member > Deactivate Account), then refresh your board (F5). Note where focus is, then press Tab once and note where it goes.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: when the dialog closes, focus returns to a sensible place (you can see it and keep working without the mouse). Write down where it went.
  • Step 5: after Golf Co leaves the filtered results and the board is refreshed, the keyboard user can carry on: one press of Tab lands on a visible element (for example the "Skip to main content" link). Write down where.
  • Step 6: after Ben becomes inactive and the board is refreshed, the keyboard user can carry on: one press of Tab lands on a visible element. Write down where.
  • Where focus should go is not designed yet. A refresh always starts focus at the top of the page, so focus being at the top right after the refresh is normal and is not a fault (QA lead's ruling below). Pass if focus is visible, or becomes visible with one Tab, and the keyboard user can carry on. Fail only if focus cannot be seen and Tab does not bring it to a visible element.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Epic SV-10043; story SV-10054 (Story 11, Keyboard access and focus); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S11-R6, S11-E1, S11-E2, Story 11 user story, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions page 853901313, SQ-15 (Open) and UX-19 (Open). Inline PRD comment by Slavcho Mitrov, 28 Sep 2026, lists what is still open with design. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) Phase 11.
  • QA lead's ruling, 12 Oct 2026, in the QA session chat. Question put to him: “Defect 2, the keyboard cursor after a card or technician column leaves the board: the requirements say where the cursor goes is still to be designed, and the test's own refresh step always sends it to the top of the page. What should I do?” His answer, word for word: “No ticket, mark Passed”. This test was changed on 12 Oct 2026 under Rule 114(d) so that focus at the top of the page after the refresh also passes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R6: “Design must define where focus returns after a dialog closes.”
  • S11-E1: “Design must define focus recovery when a work order leaves the filter result.”
  • S11-E2: “Design must define focus recovery when a technician becomes inactive.”
  • Story 11 user story: “As a keyboard user, I want to navigate work orders and their actions so that these controls are usable without a mouse.”
  • Story 11 design line: “keyboard interaction design pending”
